values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753710 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753710 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a campsite, a vault toilet and a hand launch, but the page also says 'No boat access. This creek is very shallow and not accessible for boats of any kind.' ADA accessibility rated 'Difficult'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753710 (Facilities: 'Campsite', 'Toilet (Vault)', 'Hand Launch'; 'No boat access. This creek is very shallow and not accessible for boats of any kind.'; ADA Accessibility 'Difficult Accessibility'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site (0.72 acres, ~3,740 ft) on Little Prickly Pear Creek with designated primitive camping. Directions (FWP): Take Wolf Creek Exit 226 off I-15, then 6 miles south on Recreation Rd. No trailer length limit published by FWP. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping, vault toilet, campsite, hand launch (with a 'no boat access' caveat). Added the 7-day stay limit. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, trailer length, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note trimmed of restated facilities, FCFS and fees.
